subject: german

moments.title: Bach's musical offering
moments.body: Bach improvises on a theme set by Frederick the Great, later expanding it into Das Musikalische Opfer.
moments.takeaway: German musical tradition included royal-court improvisation.

moments.title: Parsifal premiered
moments.body: Wagner's last opera consecrates the Bayreuth Festspielhaus's purpose-built role.
moments.takeaway: Wagner shaped both German music and German nationalism.

moments.title: Schoenberg's twelve-tone method
moments.body: Schoenberg breaks with tonality, founding serialism. He emigrates in 1933.
moments.takeaway: German-language music shaped modernism and was scattered by exile.

now.title: Tradition today
now.body: Berlin Philharmonic, Vienna Philharmonic and Salzburg Festival anchor a global classical industry. Composer-historians question Wagner's politics.
now.open_questions: Can a national musical tradition reckon with its complicity?

reflection: Few cultures have produced as much music as the German-speaking world.
